text:
devon: Quick sweep — I'm consolidating postmortem action items from INC-492 and want to close the loop on owners + dates. I pasted a small matrix below. Please reply with your name + new due date if different. (cc @carla @sam)

carla: Ack. I'll go first: I own the "storage-compaction" rollback follow-up. Targeting 2025-05-18.

sam: Got it. I'm taking the 'traffic-routing' canary plan item. ETA 2025-05-15, but might move to 05-17 depending on infra windows.

li: I can pick up the 'metrics-alert-tuning' task. Proposed date 2025-05-12. Need a quick Q: do you want alert thresholds mirrored across prod/standby?

devon: yes li — mirror to standby but use 0.7x threshold for standby. add a note in the doc.

maya: I can own the 'postmortem writeup cleanup' (format + action list). I'll finish by 2025-05-10.

carla: @devon quick blocker: engineering needs a DB snapshot from infra to validate the compaction change. @infra-bot can you confirm availability?

infra-bot: infra-bot: Snapshot request received for "storage-compaction-validate". ETA for snapshot: 2025-05-09 16:00 UTC. Will post when ready.

sam: small ask — for the canary plan, can eng-platform review the traffic split JSON? posting snippet below:
```json
{
  "canary": { "percent": 10, "duration_min": 60 },
  "fallback": "roll-to-stable"
}
```
carla: looks fine to me. should we add a max-error-rate gate?

sam: yes add max_error_rate: 0.02. I'll update the doc.

li: re: metrics task — do we have existing dashboards to copy? or should I create new ones?

maya: create new dashboards and tag them inc-492 and owner:li. Keep copy template in 'dashboards/inc-templates'.

devon: summary matrix (please confirm inline):
- storage-compaction validation — owner: carla — due: 2025-05-18 — depends on infra snapshot (2025-05-09)
- traffic-routing canary plan — owner: sam — due: 2025-05-15 (may slip to 05-17) — needs eng-platform review + max_error_rate gate
- metrics-alert-tuning — owner: li — due: 2025-05-12 — create dashboards, tag inc-492
- postmortem writeup cleanup — owner: maya — due: 2025-05-10

carla: Confirmed. I'll mark the item as in-progress in the doc and comment when snapshot is confirmed. :white_check_mark: 

sam: Confirmed for canary plan, will update JSON and add gate.

li: Confirmed. I'll start on dashboards tomorrow and post links.

maya: Confirmed and I'll push the cleaned writeup by 05-10.

devon: Thanks all. If owners foresee slips, please update the due date inline rather than reply-all. I'll run a final sweep on 2025-05-11.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Snapshot completed: storage-compaction-validate snapshot ready at 2025-05-09 16:12 UTC. Link: https://infra.example/snapshots/storage-compaction-validate

carla: Received snapshot link — starting validation now.

sam: small follow-up — can eng-sre join canary run on the 15th for the first 30min? @maya can you coordinate?

maya: yes, I'll invite eng-sre and add a calendar block for 2025-05-15 09:00-10:00 UTC and dump invite to the doc.

devon: Great. Thread locked for now — will reopen if anything changes.
